en.headline: Firefighters extinguish unit fire in Yau Ma Tei Temple Street tong lau
en.dek: The blaze in a flat at 107-109 Temple Street was put out in about 17 minutes on Sunday evening after reports of smoke, with no injuries reported and a cooking stove initially suspected.
body: Firefighters extinguished a fire in a residential unit of a tong lau on Temple Street in Yau Ma Tei on Sunday evening, with no injuries reported.

Police received multiple reports at about 9:38 p.m. of smoke coming from an upper-floor unit at 107 to 109 Temple Street. Fire crews arrived and deployed one hose and a breathing apparatus team. The fire was extinguished in about 17 minutes.

Preliminary information suggested the fire may have involved a cooking stove in the unit’s kitchen, though the exact cause remains under investigation. Water was seen being sprayed into the unit from outside as crews cooled the scene.
Nearby street vendors on Temple Street reported that some clothing displays were affected by the water used in the response. No residents were reported trapped or injured.

zh.headline: 油麻地廟街唐樓單位起火 消防約17分鐘撲熄無人傷
zh.dek: 周日晚上約9時38分廟街107至109號樓上單位冒煙，消防開喉及煙帽隊灌救，約17分鐘將火撲熄，初步懷疑煮食爐肇禍。
body: 油麻地廟街一幢唐樓單位周日晚上發生火警，消防人員約17分鐘將火撲熄，事件中無人受傷。
警方於晚上約9時38分接獲多宗報案，指廟街107至109號一個樓上單位冒煙。消防到場後動用一條喉及一隊煙帽隊灌救，火勢於約17分鐘後受控並撲滅。
初步資料顯示，火警可能涉及單位廚房的煮食爐，確切原因仍有待調查。現場可見消防向單位射水降溫。
附近廟街攤檔有貨品受射水影響。沒有報告指有居民被困或受傷。
